title: Inter: Lautaro finished 22nd in the Ballon d'Or
caption:
Inter captain Lautaro Martínez finished 22nd in the 2026 Ballon d'Or, per Inter.it — his fifth nomination, and the only Serie A player among the 30 finalists. Harry Kane won it in London.
